ttl.description:
Duration category for cached content.

| Category | Minimum | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `short` | 1 min | Very short-lived, single interaction |
| `medium` | 30 min | Session-scoped, multi-turn conversation |
| `long` | 4 hours | Long-lived, cross-session reuse |

Default: `short`

Providers that honor this hint MUST cache for at least the specified minimum duration.

title: Cache hint
description: A cache hint indicating that content is stable and suitable for caching. The presence of this object signals caching intent; providers MAY honor this hint to optimize repeated requests. Behavior is provider-specific; hints may be ignored.
